title: Lubricant R&D material registration
description: Design-space material object (break-point B4). Before this schema, materials appeared only as name strings inside formulas and experiment records, so a base oil could not carry its supplier, lot, chemistry family, measured properties, or price. One material record fixes one physical material: identity (supplier / trade name / lot), chemistry family, a non-empty property list, and a dated price. Every property is bound to a source, an evidence_id, and a status, so a property the supplier has not supplied is recorded as a GAP instead of being invented.
$comment: Domain reason for the property list: grease soap-fibre formation depends on base-oil solvency and polarity (aniline point class), NOT on viscosity - two PAOs with the same KV100 can give different grease consistency, so a viscosity-only material record cannot predict thickener behaviour. Recommended base-oil property ids, documented only and deliberately NOT in required: kv40, kv100, vi, density, pour_point, flash_point, aniline_point, polarity. A supplier may not have them yet; the pack rule is to record a GAP, never invent a value.

properties.description: Measured or supplied properties of this material. minItems 1: a material with no recorded property at all is not a design-space input. A property the supplier has not supplied is recorded with status GAP rather than omitted or guessed.

identity.description: Who the material physically is. The lot is required because a property measured on one lot does not transfer to another lot without evidence.

chemistry.description: Chemistry family of the material. base_oil_family is the solvency / polarity class that drives soap-fibre formation in a grease; notes is free text for anything else the supplier states, including a NOT_APPLICABLE note for a SEAL or SOLID_FILLER entry.

property_entry.description: One material property. value accepts a number or a string so a qualitative supplier statement stays recordable; status must state whether it was OBSERVED, ASSUMED, or is a GAP.

property_id.description: Free id of the property. Recommended base-oil ids (documentation only, not required): kv40, kv100, vi, density, pour_point, flash_point, aniline_point, polarity.

cost.description: Price snapshot for this material at a stated date. price_timestamp is required: without it a cost cannot be compared across quotes or periods.
